newsitem.title: USA: America West names Goodmanson president.
newsitem.headline: America West names Goodmanson president.

text.p: America West Holdings Corp said Richard Goodmanson was named president of America West Holdings and president and chief executive officer of America West Airlines.
W. A. Franke will remain as chairman of the airline and as chairman and chief executive officer of its parent company, America West Holdings Corp.

Goodmanson achieved his American citizenship last month, which is a federal prerequisite to becoming chief executive officer of a U.S. flag carrier. Although a resident of the U.S. for more than 13 years, he is originally from Australia.
Prior to today's announcement, Goodmanson was executive vice president and chief operating officer of America West Airlines and executive vice president of America West Holdings.
Goodmanson replaces Franke as president and chief executive officer of America West Airlines. His title as president of the holding company is a new title.
